name: subscribe__max_interval_keepalive
description: Locks the matter.js-aligned heartbeat cadence: after a subscription is admitted, if no dirty marks arrive within min(MaxIntervalCeiling/2, 30 s), the engine MUST ship an empty-payload ReportData (keepalive) so Apple Home's MTRDevice / chip-tool's ReadClient does not drop the subscription. The scenario picks MaxIntervalCeiling=2 (a 2 s keep-alive: maxInterval × 0.8 = 1.6 s, raised to matter.js's MIN_INTERVAL of 2 s in ServerSubscription.ts), waits 1 s without firing any change so the 2 s receive window covers the keep-alive, and asserts it arrives with attribute_reports_count=0.
